npmerger: Build Nonprofit Merger Datasets from IRS 990 Efile Data

Source: R/npmerger-package.R
npmerger-package.Rd

Pipeline stages, each a separate function so users can enter at any point:

Details

  1. Retrieve: get_schedule_n() downloads Schedule N tables through 'panel990'.

  2. Transactions: sn_transactions() stacks Part I and Part II asset lines into one long table, and sn_filings() builds one row per Schedule N filing.

  3. Classify: classify_transactions() labels each filing (merger2, mergerN, consolidation, asset_transfer, closure, asset_disposition, reorganization, other) using rules from merger_rules().

  4. Cases and tables: merger IDs (merger_id()) plus the donor, recipient, Part VII and fiscal panels (in development).
